text: In the single-node delay reservoir, the total loop delay τ equals the number of virtual nodes N times the inter-node interval θ (τ = N·θ).
explanation: True. The delay interval is partitioned into N equal sub-intervals of width θ, so τ = N·θ (in Lab 15, θ = 1). Choosing a smaller θ (or longer τ) packs in more virtual nodes; this relation is what turns one physical node into an N-dimensional reservoir.
